svg.title: Sensor swap: a 25 mg/dL step
svg.desc: Real 1-minute readings across a sensor swap with a 25 mg/dL step. Kalman with the session split restarts at the new level; the same Kalman without session information treats the step as a fast rise and briefly reports a large positive delta.
svg.text: iAPS splits the smoothing at the session change, so the step reaches oref's delta in full (+25). A 16-min gap follows.
Newest value each loop cycle would have used
oref delta (mg/dL per 5 min) each cycle
